title: Extract Generic Comparison Hook to Eliminate Code Duplication
description: Create a generic useComparison hook that consolidates the duplicated comparison logic across useCompareDeputies, useCompareParties, and useCompareDistricts. The compare() function is duplicated verbatim in two hooks, and the winner calculation logic is repeated in all three.
